duplication_audit.novel_axis: past-only alternating directional-change confirmations and overshoot-duration geometry in intrinsic event time
duplication_audit.distinction: v40 counts crossings and excursions relative to fixed absolute levels; v54 pairs closed rainflow cycles; v66 counts new all-time records; v67 estimates one Pettitt rank change; v77 weights every increment in natural time. v78 instead maintains a running local extremum and confirms alternating up/down regimes only after a fixed reversal amplitude, then summarizes completed overshoots and regime durations. It is not a spectrum, pole, codifference, pairwise-causality estimator, or reuse of prior outputs.
duplication_audit.repository_negative_fingerprint: No executed P3 directional-change, intrinsic-time reversal confirmation, drawup/drawdown overshoot, or alternating threshold-event feature contract was found.
duplication_audit.official_exclusion: official feedback is excluded from features, gates, model fitting and candidate selection

encoder.input: past-only hs/tp/hmax/wspd on the native context, linearly filled within the observed prefix and sampled on the fixed 20-minute grid
encoder.normalization: case-window median and 1.4826*MAD; constant paths map to zero
encoder.event_contract: running-extremum directional-change confirmations alternate by construction; completed trend excess beyond delta is overshoot

model.target: six-lead target_hs minus exact uniform alpha 0.425 reference
model.train_fold_scaler: median and IQR, clip standardized features to [-8,8]

validation.surface: EXPLORATORY_ONLY repeatedly exposed 182 complete historical cases
validation.gate: pooled delta<0, >=4/6 blocks, episode and block-station CI90 upper<0, sealed block/lead/station-lead/reference-tail guards

primary_sources.citation: Guillaume, Dacorogna, Dave, Muller, Olsen, and Pictet, From the bird's eye to the microscope: A survey of new stylized facts of the intra-daily foreign exchange markets, Finance and Stochastics 1, 95-129 (1997)
primary_sources.use: directional-change intrinsic-time definition motivation only; no P3 performance claim
